blocks.text: Want to learn a language, coding, guitar or history? AI can be your personal teacher, adapted to your pace.

items: Say what you already know and what you want to achieve.
Ask for a week-by-week learning plan.
Learn in small chunks: explanation, example, small task.
Ask it to quiz you – active recall is the best way to learn.
Explain to the AI in your own words what you learned and ask it to correct you.

blocks.text: I want to learn Excel basics for work in 4 weeks, 3 times a week for 30 minutes. I only know how to open a file. Make a plan, then let's start the first lesson: explanation, example and a small task.
You can ask the AI not to give you answers but to guide you with questions: "Don't give me the solution, ask me questions until I get there myself."
You learn best when you make an effort to remember, not when you only read. So always ask for a quiz at the end.
Some versions of Claude have a learning mode that guides you with questions instead of giving the answer straight away.
ChatGPT has a study mode that guides you step by step.
Gemini has a guided learning tool that explains things step by step.
